newsitem.title: USA: Sonoco sees 1st half of 97 EPS flat or down.
newsitem.headline: Sonoco sees 1st half of 97 EPS flat or down.

text.p: Sonoco Products Co said Wednesday it expects earnings in the first of 1997 to be flat or slightly down for a variety of reasons.

Chairman and Chief Executive C.W. Coker said in a statement that the factors that affected its fourth quarter earnings -- shortfalls in a few newer businesses, investments in new initiatives and price decreases -- would affect the first of 1997.

"Improvement is expected in the second half of 1997 as we begin to realize benefits from growth and cost-reduction initiatives and more favorable prior-year price/cost comparisons," Coker said. "We believe our heaviest reorganization and start-up costs are behind us in the new businesses and are confident of good improvements in 1997."

For the fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $40.96 million, or $0.42 per fully diluted share, on sales of $725.57 million. In the prior year's fourth quarter, the company reported net income of $42.23 million, or $0.42 per fully diluted share, on sales of $682.31 million.
